exposure: isolated elevation of 50g Glucose Challenge Test (GCT)
maternal weight > 80kg at first pregnancy visit
cohort: The study included 177 pregnant women who applied to an antenatal clinic and were screened for Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM), along with their 177 infants.
finding: Patients with isolated elevation of the 50g Glucose Challenge Test are at risk of fetal macrosomia, which subsequently increases the risk of cesarean section.
mod_finding: Fetal macrosomia, associated with isolated elevated 50g GCT levels, was linked to a higher rate of emergent cesarean section due to cephalopelvic disproportion.
